items.html: But in Abba and Ima there is Mah and Ban, except that they are two Partzufim joined together always face to face, similar to Atik, and they are joined to such a degree that the two are considered one Partzuf, and it is called Abba. And so it is likewise in Ima, for they are two Partzufim of Mah and Ban, except that they are very tightly joined face to face, similar to Atik, as mentioned above.
